Quest.Title: The Evolution Pendant
Quest.Script: Urgent: This is "Terry" from the EVE territory. I’m ordering you to return to guild headquarters immediately. You’ve been assigned a special mission, so please return as soon as possible to receive it. What do you say? Can you head back now?

Complete.Script: From now on, listen carefully to every word I say. This mission has been assigned by higher-ups, and I’m not entirely clear on the details myself. But there’s one thing I want you to understand: this mission is top secret, so you must never let it get out.

Here, take this... All you have to do is deliver it to the designated location. Please hand it over to Rebecca, the vampire in Linbao City. Of course, you don’t need to worry about getting into Linbao City―we’ve already taken care of everything. To maintain secrecy, you must not use motorcycles or helicopters for this operation.
Thanks for all your hard work! How do you feel? To be able to see the majestic Limbo City from such a humble position...….
Thanks for all your hard work this time. Oh, and here, take this. Bye! … I wonder if we'll ever see each other again... Hahaha ….
Complete.SayNPC: Give Rebecca's reply to Terry in Eslanian City.
Complete.Script: Thank you! I might need your help again. Please don’t go far―just stay nearby and wait for my message.

Quest.FailMessage: Oh, man! I ended up coming back empty-handed... You've really let me down.

Fail.Killed: If you die during the mission, the mission is canceled and you have to start over.

Quest.Title: The Gate of the Altar
Quest.Script: I’m “Terry” from the EVE territory. The higher-ups are very pleased with your previous performance. Now, they’ve assigned a new mission. I’ve heard that a passage leading into the heart of Adam City has been discovered in the city’s central district. So, I’d like to ask you to investigate it. Would that be okay?

Complete.EnterDynamicZone: Go find the "Altar Gate" leading to "Adam City."
Complete.ClearDynamicZone: You must use the monster's blood to create a "magic circle" within the allotted time, then find the passage to Adam City.
Complete.Script: Oh no, something doesn't feel right... According to the latest report, the Altar Gate has been sealed by magic circles... six in total...
Complete.EnterDynamicZone: You can only enter the altar by using the magic circle.
Complete.Script: "The Fall. 'Once the magic circle was activated, we were plunged into a dark hell.'"
Hell. 'It was filled with the corpses of humans and vampires, with pools of blood everywhere and a suffocating stench.'
"Sacrifices. 'The souls of my companions have been taken over by demons; they look so haggard amid the demons' laughter.'"
"So... is this mission meant to use us as sacrifices? Could it be that the letter back then... was sent so that the leaders of both sides could join forces..."
Question: "What exactly is the point of treating us as sacrifices?"
Complete.ClearDynamicZone: After defeating monsters to obtain the "Spiral of Life," use it to save humanity!

Quest.FailMessage: Oh, man! I ended up coming back empty-handed... You've really let me down.

Fail.Killed: If you die during the mission, the mission is canceled and you have to start over.

Quest.Script: Go find "Terry." Terry is located "NorthWest of Eslanian City."

Complete.Script: 'The higher-ups in EVE would actually do something like this... They're no different from vampires. They absolutely cannot be forgiven.'
Congratulations on successfully completing the task.
What? That's... No, wait... I don't know anything about that.
Can you please calm down? It’s because...
Complete.ClearDynamicZone: While protecting the "Seal of Rationality," you must not die within "10 minutes."

Quest.FailMessage: Oh, man! I ended up coming back empty-handed... You've really let me down.

Quest.Title: The Evolution Pendant
Quest.Script: What is going on? I have been looking for you for so long, and only now you reply... Really. What, you cannot even recognize my voice? I am Seth... Seth of Limbo City. When you were little, whenever I had something good I sent it to you first. Anyway, come to me first. The director assigned an important mission to you, and bring some good things while you are at it!

Complete.Script: You are here! It has been a long time. How have you been? Let us talk about the mission first. The master has issued a special task. Remember! This operation must be conducted in secret, so do not leak a word. What? As long as I do not leak the secret, that is enough. Damn...

Here, take this... All you have to do is deliver it to the designated location. Please hand it over to the human captain Kaiser. Do not ask me anything else, because I do not know the reason either... Remember! Get rid of any thought of biting Kaiser's neck... Also, during the mission do not transform into a bat or open a seal. Do not forget! This operation is secret.
Complete.SayNPC: Give the document to Kaiser, northwest of Eslanian City.
Complete.Script: Is that all? Do not do anything rash. Stay put.
That is enough. Take this. Be careful on the road! Oh, and I hope we do not meet again. Next time you will not be so lucky.
Complete.SayNPC: Give Kaiser's reply to Seth in Limbo City.
Complete.Script: Haha! You are back. You worked hard this time. The master may have something else to assign, so wait a bit.

Quest.FailMessage: Oh, man! I ended up coming back empty-handed... You've really let me down.

Fail.Killed: If you die during the mission, the mission is canceled and you have to start over.

This time the master still wants your help! Have you heard of Adam City? They say a passage into the heart of Adam City has been discovered in the city's central district. So, I would like to ask you to investigate it. Would that be okay?

Quest.Title: The Evolution Pendant
Quest.Script: I am Hora of the spirit village. I am using the power of the spirits to deliver this order. Lady Lavia has an important matter for you, so please return to the village at once. As for what it is, I do not know either. I will say it again: return to the village as soon as possible. We truly need your help. Will you come back now?

Complete.Script: Thank you for coming to help us. Lady Lavia has an important mission to assign to you.

Here, take this... All you have to do is deliver it to the designated location. Please hand it over to the vampire "Lariba." As long as you are in spirit form and carry this token, you will be able to see him. I have already used the power of the spirits to cast a spell on you. In a moment your body and soul will separate. Do not worry; I will keep your body safe. Now go find "Lariba." Remember! In spirit form you cannot cast magic or attack. You will not be attacked either. Good luck!
Complete.SayNPC: Give the secret letter to Lariba in southern Limbo City.
Complete.Script: You actually found this place. Who is this spirit? This is Lavia's...
You worked hard! Take this. Also, please tell Lavia that many puzzling things have been happening between humans and vampires lately. It is hard to imagine they would join forces...
Complete.SayNPC: Give Lariba's reply to Hora in the spirit village.
Complete.Script: You worked hard! I was worried you would not make it back. What? Between humans and vampires... If Lariba said so, then it must be true. Please rest assured, I will report this to Lady Lavia. If I need anything later, I will find you again.

Quest.FailMessage: Oh, man! I ended up coming back empty-handed... You've really let me down.
